comment: The Steam bridge's own inputs, pinned like the engine's (scripts/fetch.py reads this file the same way). A release build refuses any entry whose size or sha256 is null; a test build downloads it, prints the values to pin and goes on. proton.py checks the unpacked tree against tree_sha256 either way, so what is built is pinned even before the tarball's own values are.

bridge.name: mavrik-steam-bridge
bridge.engine: built and gated against the engine scripts/build.sh made in the same work folder (cx26.3.0-r8: patch 0004 is the loader half of the bridge; 0007 to 0033 touch none of the bridge's files, and the bridge links that engine's ntdll.so, which 0018 to 0024 and 0033 change)

proton-source.licence: lsteamclient/: the Steamworks SDK licence (lsteamclient/LICENSE); steam_helper/: BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE.proton)
proton-source.note: Valve's Proton without its submodules. Only the members are unpacked. tree_sha256 was computed from git's objects for this commit (git archive), with proton.py digest; GitHub's tarball of the same commit must unpack to it.
